name: Xu Jingyang Moving His Family
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
dimensions: Overall: 268.2 x 66 cm (105 9/16 x 26 in.); Painting only: 165.3 x 64 cm (65 1/16 x 25 3/16 in.); Overall with knobs: 268.2 x 74.1 cm (105 9/16 x 29 3/16 in.)
summary: Xu Jingyang was a dedicated fourth-century Confucian official who allegedly turned into a Daoist immortal.
